risk_if_not_implemented: Without Alternate Processing Site Accessibility, data, software and system images cannot be reliably restored within required recovery objectives following a disruption. Based on the risk and threat mapping for this control, this deficiency most likely exposes the organization to Recovery Failure / Unacceptable Recovery Delay (R-OR-1), and most likely increases susceptibility to natural threats NT-2, NT-3, NT-4, NT-5, NT-6, NT-7, NT-8, NT-11, NT-12, NT-13, NT-14; Civil or Political Unrest (MT-1), Transportation / Logistics Disruption (MT-26), Infrastructure Failure / Degradation (MT-27).

compensating_control_1.name: Reserve Hardware
compensating_control_1.description: Mechanisms exist to purchase and maintain a sufficient reserve of spare hardware to ensure essential missions and business functions can be maintained in the event of a supply chain disruption.
compensating_control_1.justification: Reserve Hardware (BCD-20) provides overlapping security capability that compensates for the absence of Alternate Processing Site Accessibility (BCD-13.2) by addressing related risk objectives through an alternative control mechanism aligned with Facility applicability. Given the facility and physical environment focus of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.

compensating_control_2.name: Elastic Expansion
compensating_control_2.description: Mechanisms exist to automatically scale the resources available for Technology Assets, Applications and/or Services (TAAS), as demand conditions change.
compensating_control_2.justification: Elastic Expansion (CAP-06) provides overlapping security capability that compensates for the absence of Alternate Processing Site Accessibility (BCD-13.2) by addressing related risk objectives through an alternative control mechanism aligned with Facility applicability. Given the facility and physical environment focus of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.
